# MCP and chat tools

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-mcp-docs.ts from ORBIT_TOOLS. Do not edit by hand. -->

Orbit's tools are defined once, in [`src/lib/tools/definitions.ts`](../src/lib/tools/definitions.ts), and
offered to two surfaces: the MCP server (`/api/mcp`) and Orbit's own chat. A `write` tool is hidden from a
read-only API key. Read the security comment at the top of `src/lib/mcp/server.ts` before adding a tool:
no tool may send, fetch a URL, register a webhook or approve a draft.

The REST API is described separately by `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` on any deployment
(source: `src/app/api/v1/openapi.json/route.ts`).

Regenerate with `npx tsx scripts/gen-mcp-docs.ts`.

## search_contacts

**Search contacts**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

Search the user's professional network by name, company, school, role or free text. Returns matching people with how close the relationship is.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 200 | What to look for. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 25, default 10 |  |

Returned fields on mcp: `id`, `name`, `company`, `title`, `school`, `location`, `closenessTier`, `relevance`, `summary`.

Returned fields on chat: `id`, `name`, `company`, `title`, `school`, `location`, `closenessTier`, `relevance`, `summary`, `notes`.

## get_contact

**Get one contact**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

Everything Orbit knows about one person, including recent interactions. Use search_contacts first to find their id.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

## who_do_i_know_at

**Who do I know at a company**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

The people in the user's network at a given company or organisation — the warm path in.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `company` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 200 |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 20, default 10 |  |

## due_followups

**Who to follow up with**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

People the user owes a follow-up, or whose relationship is going cold.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 25, default 10 |  |

## list_reminders

**List reminders**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

The user's reminders and to-dos: what is due today, what is coming up, what has no date, and what is already done. Use due_followups instead for people going cold.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `view` | "today" \| "upcoming" \| "anytime" \| "done" | no | default "today" | today includes anything overdue. |
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | no |  | Only this person's reminders. |
| `query` | string | no | max length 200 | Match the title or contact name. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 50, default 20 |  |

## get_network_overview

**Network overview**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

How big the user's network is and how it is doing right now: totals, inner circle, recent activity, what is overdue. Good for a weekly review or a first question.

_No input._

## get_timeline

**One person's history**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

The dated history with one person — meetings, calls, notes and messages, newest first — and a total for the range. Use it for when they last spoke, how often they meet, or what happened over a period; narrow with since/until (YYYY-MM-DD). get_contact returns only the handful most recent.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `since` | string | no |  | Only entries on or after this day. |
| `until` | string | no |  | Only entries on or before this day. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 20, default 10 |  |

## get_goals

**What the user is working towards**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

The user's active networking goals, in their own words. Use it when a question is open-ended — who to reconnect with, who matters right now, what to say — so the answer serves what they are actually trying to do.

_No input._

## find_path_to

**Find a way in**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

Who in the user's network could open a door to a company, a school or a person, ranked by how well the user actually knows them. Give an organisation ("Stripe") or a person's name. If that person is already in the network it says so, because then there is no path to find.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | yes | min length 2, max length 200 | A company, a school, or a person's name. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 15, default 8 |  |

## search_notes

**Search your notes**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Search what the user has written — notes, meeting and call logs — by meaning and by words. Use it for what was discussed, said or promised, and when; for details that are not in a contact's summary; and for questions that name a topic rather than a person. Narrow by person with contactId and by date with after/before (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns dated passages with the people they mention.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 200 | What to look for, in plain words. |
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | no |  | Only passages about this person. |
| `after` | string | no |  | Only passages on or after this day. |
| `before` | string | no |  | Only passages on or before this day. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 8, default 6 |  |

Returned fields on chat: `sourceId`, `date`, `kind`, `contactIds`, `snippet`.

## search_meetings

**Search your recorded meetings**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Search the transcripts and summaries of calls the user recorded with Orbit, by the words in them. Use it when the question is about a call: what came up about a topic, what was decided, what someone said in a meeting. Give short keywords — a name or a topic — not a whole sentence. Each passage says when in the meeting something was said but NOT who said it: speakers are not named, so never attribute a line to a person. A name matches the meetings that person was invited to. Narrow by date with after/before (YYYY-MM-DD).

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 200 | Keywords: a topic and/or a name. |
| `after` | string | no |  | Only meetings on or after this day. |
| `before` | string | no |  | Only meetings on or before this day. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 8, default 6 |  |

Returned fields on chat: `meetingId`, `title`, `date`, `startMs`, `kind`, `snippet`.

## upcoming_meetings

**The user's calendar**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

Meetings and events on the user's calendar, from two days ago to two weeks ahead. Use it for anything about their schedule: what is on today or tomorrow, when they next see someone, who they are meeting this week, or which meeting "my 3pm" is. Each event has the attendees Orbit knows (contactId), so follow up with get_contact or get_timeline to prepare for a meeting. Times are already in the user's own time zone. Narrow by day with after/before (YYYY-MM-DD, the user's local days) and to one person with contactId.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no |  | Only events on or after this local day. Default: now. |
| `before` | string | no |  | Only events on or before this local day. Default: a week ahead. |
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | no |  | Only events this person is on. |
| `query` | string | no | max length 100 | Match words in the event title. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 50, default 20 |  |

Returned fields on mcp: `eventId`, `title`, `day`, `start`, `end`, `timeZone`, `call`, `response`, `attendees`, `attendeeCount`, `guestListHidden`.

## free_time

**When the user is free**. Scope: `read`. Surface: MCP and in-app chat.

The gaps between the user's meetings, per day, inside 9:00–18:00 in their own time zone — for "when am I free", "do I have time Thursday afternoon" or finding a slot to suggest. Declined meetings don't count as busy; all-day events are ignored. Days are YYYY-MM-DD in the user's zone, at most two weeks ahead.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no |  | First local day. Default: today. |
| `before` | string | no |  | Last local day. Default: the same as after. |
| `minMinutes` | integer | no | min 15, max 240, default 30 | Shortest gap worth reporting. |

## meeting_context

**Prepare for a meeting**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Everything worth knowing before one meeting, in one call: the event, and for each attendee Orbit knows their standing and suggested next step, the last few times you spoke, and what is still open with them. Pick the meeting by eventId (from upcoming_meetings), by local time ("15:00" for "my 3pm", optionally with a day), or by words in its title; with none of those it is the next meeting with someone you know. It reads who the meeting is with from the title too, and searches the web for up to two of them (their profile: role, summary, talking points with links). Use it for "prep me", "what should I know before…" and "who is on my next call".

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | string (uuid) | no |  |  |
| `time` | string | no |  | Local start time, 24-hour: "15:00" for 3pm. |
| `day` | string | no |  | Local day for time. Default: the next one at that time. |
| `query` | string | no | max length 100 | Words in the event title. |

## research_person

**Research someone outside the network**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Search the public web for a person who is NOT in the user's network — someone they are about to meet, were introduced to, or want to reach. Only use it after search_contacts found nobody by that name. Needs the person's name plus at least one of company, domain or linkedinUrl; a name alone is refused. Returns a short cited brief: current role, summary, things worth bringing up, and source links. match 'unsure' means the pages might be about a namesake: say so, and report no facts as theirs. It can take a while; if it times out, tell the user they can finish it on Find people.

Offered only while the `page.find` surface is released to the asker.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | min length 2, max length 100 | Their full name. |
| `company` | string | no | max length 100 | Where they work. |
| `domain` | string | no | max length 253 | Their company's website domain, e.g. stripe.com. |
| `linkedinUrl` | string | no | max length 300 |  |

Returned fields on chat: `match`, `name`, `headline`, `currentRole`, `location`, `summary`, `talkingPoints`, `experience`, `sources`, `note`.

## research_company

**Research a company on the web**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Search the public web for a company: what they do, recent news, and people there worth talking to, each with the page that names them. Use it when the user asks about a company beyond who they already know there — use who_do_i_know_at for that, first. match 'unsure' means it might be a different company with the same name: say so, and report nothing as fact. It can take a while; if it times out, tell the user they can finish it on Find people.

Offered only while the `page.find` surface is released to the asker.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | min length 2, max length 100 | The company's name. |
| `domain` | string | no | max length 253 | Their website domain, e.g. stripe.com, if known. |

Returned fields on chat: `match`, `name`, `website`, `description`, `headquarters`, `founded`, `size`, `news`, `people`, `sources`, `note`.

## find_people

**Find new people on the web**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Search the public web for people the user does NOT know yet who match a description — a role, a company, a school, a place: "product managers at Stripe who went to Michigan". Use it only when the user asks to find new people or people outside their network; for who they already know, use search_contacts or who_do_i_know_at. Returns at most 10 people, each with the page that shows the match and why they fit. It is never a complete list — say so. It can take a while; if it times out, tell the user they can finish it on Find people.

Offered only while the `page.find` surface is released to the asker.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | min length 3, max length 300 | Who to look for, in plain words. |

Returned fields on chat: `query`, `candidates`, `note`.

## list_open_commitments

**What the user owes**. Scope: `read`. Surface: In-app chat only.

Open promises and to-dos across the whole network: reminders that are overdue or due today, reminders with no date, and action items taken from notes. Narrow to one person with contactId. Use list_reminders for what is coming up later, and due_followups for people going quiet.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | no |  | Only what is owed to this person. |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1, max 25, default 15 |  |

Returned fields on chat: `kind`, `id`, `contactId`, `contactName`, `text`, `dueDate`, `sourceId`.

## log_interaction

**Log an interaction**. Scope: `write`. Surface: MCP only.

Record that the user talked to someone — a meeting, a call, an email or a message.

| `contactId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `notes` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 5000 |  |

## request_send

**Write an email for the user to send**. Scope: `write`. Surface: MCP only.

Draft an email and put it in front of the user for approval. THIS DOES NOT SEND ANYTHING. The user reads the recipient and the message in Orbit and decides; tell them the draft is waiting rather than implying it has gone out.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | string (email) | yes |  | The recipient's email address. |
| `subject` | string | no | max length 200 |  |
| `body` | string | yes | min length 1, max length 5000 |  |
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | no |  | The Orbit contact this is for, when there is one. |
| `clientName` | string | no | max length 80 | Your product's name, shown to the user on the approval card. |

## get_send_status

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `draftId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |

## schedule_follow_up

**Schedule a follow-up**. Scope: `write`. Surface: MCP only.

Put someone back on the user's calendar in a number of days. Reuses their pending reminder if they already have one, rather than creating a second.

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contactId` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `days` | integer | no | min 1, max 90, default 7 |  |

## create_contact

**Add a contact**. Scope: `write`. Surface: MCP only.

Add someone new to the user's network. Checks for an existing match first and refuses rather than creating a duplicate unless force is set.

| `email` | string (email) | no |  |  |
| `company` | string | no | max length 200 |  |
| `title` | string | no | max length 200 |  |
| `linkedinUrl` | string | no | max length 500 |  |
| `notes` | string | no | max length 5000 |  |
